'''Karfeddion''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Tarkin" /> located in the [[Karfeddion system]] in the [[Senex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]. It was situated in grid square L-18 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]],<ref name="Appendix" /> at the confluence of numerous [[hyperspace route]]s.<ref name="Map" /> [[Standard year|Years]] prior to the [[Battle of Naboo]], [[Q'anah's lover]], a [[pirate]] leader in the Senex and member of [[House Elegin]], was captured, sentenced to [[death]], and executed on Karfeddion.<ref name="Tarkin" />
